title: Created a small local model that judges what players say (lies, threats, jailbreaks, agree/refuse). Free playground + looking for alpha testers
author: NoahPersaud
selftext:
I've been building GameDecider: a small (\~400M) model that answers yes/no and multiple-choice questions about what a player just said or did. Your game logic can react to free text without an LLM improvising the rules. This model was inspired by Jev



You give it the game state, the line and a question ("is this a threat?", "did they agree, refuse or counter-offer?", "does this contradict what they said earlier?"). It answers with one of your options, a confidence, and "not sure" when it's unsure, so you can fall back to your own logic.



Try it in your browser, no signup: [https://huggingface.co/spaces/P1ayer-1/gamedecider-playground](https://huggingface.co/spaces/P1ayer-1/gamedecider-playground)



\- About 0.2 s per question on a CPU locally; it runs offline as ONNX

\- A cookbook of 26 ready-made questions; 23 of them are 80%+ on our tests

\- "Compile" a question you care about with your own examples for better results



It's alpha, and it's honestly weaker on some things: judging persuasion and brand-new kinds of questions.



Looking for \~10 devs to try it in a real project: dialogue games, AI NPCs, social sims, anything with typed or voice input. You get the local server and model, Unity/Godot/Unreal/JS/Python snippets, help integrating, and a free compile of your own questions. Comment or email [noah@holdoutlabs.ai](mailto:noah@holdoutlabs.ai) with what you're building.



Happy to answer questions about how it works.
